en.headline: Airside opens Kuromi Starlit Sweet Party with six-metre installation
en.dek: The Kai Tak mall launches a dessert-themed Sanrio event from today until 8 November, featuring a tall Kuromi macaron sculpture, photo spots and a limited pop-up store.
body: Airside in Kai Tak has opened the Starlit Sweet Party event in partnership with Sanrio from 14 October to 8 November at the atrium on the second floor.

The centrepiece is a six-metre-tall installation of Kuromi seated on a giant pink macaron. Visitors will also find three photo spots themed around a cookie arch, cream-whisking and a heart-shaped toast.

A pop-up store at the same location runs from 11am to 9pm and introduces Hong Kong’s first Kuromi Dreamy Dessert Series and Sanrio Characters Baking Series items, including a baker-style keychain making its debut there. A bakery experience in which selected character keychains are scented with the aroma of fresh bread is scheduled on specific dates starting 17 October, with some sessions reserved for app members.

zh.headline: 啟德Airside推出Kuromi魔幻烘焙所 設6米高裝置
zh.dek: 商場由今日起至11月8日在二樓中庭舉行Sanrio主題活動，設有巨型Kuromi馬卡龍裝置、打卡位及期間限定店。
body: 啟德Airside與Sanrio合作，由10月14日起至11月8日在二樓中庭呈獻「Starlit Sweet Party魔幻烘焙所」。
場內焦點是一座6米高的Kuromi裝置，角色坐在巨型粉紅色馬卡龍上。另外設有三個拍照區，主題分別為曲奇拱門、打發忌廉及心形吐司。
同場期間限定店由上午11時至晚上9時營業，引入香港首發的Kuromi夢幻甜品系列及Sanrio角色烘焙系列產品，包括麵包師傅造型鑰匙扣率先在此發售。另設烘焙工房體驗，由10月17日起在指定日期舉行，部分場次預留給應用程式會員。
